title: 第3章 陈晓云的承诺第4章 姬云生的口粮
content_zh:
陈晓云一听，温柔笑着回答道：“知道了爹爹，我保证以后都不会了，可以了吧！这话你都说了那么多次了，女儿都听烦了。”陈明见状，也是无奈笑了笑回答道：“爹爹不说了不说了，我们赶紧回去做饭吃吧，小家伙应该也是饿了，毕竟小家伙才那么小，
可不能把他饿坏了。”陈晓云一听，一脸严肃说道：“爹爹，我可以不记恨娘亲，但等我修为足够后，害的爹爹修为尽失之人，我是一定不会放过一人的。这事就这么决定了，不论对方是何人，爹爹到时候可不能阻拦我。”陈明一听笑着回答道：“
晓云，爹爹知道了，到时候等你了解过后，你要是想报仇，爹爹肯定不会阻止你的。”姬云生心里喃喃道：“我去，听两人说了那么多，这事难道有什么隐情？看样子晓云的娘亲，应该是和这事没有一点关系，毕竟当初看了那么多小说，不是白看的。
可惜老子如今只是个婴儿，没有办法帮助他们，只希望到时候去往那个什么宗门的话，我能有修炼的资质吧！毕竟这两人对我现在而言，是救命之恩，可不能不帮助他们。老子真是服了，到底是哪个王八犊子带老子来这里的，说好的金手指也没有，
什么遇到修仙大能老爷爷也没有。我是真的服了，老子不会只是穿越过来当个配角吧！要是我能修炼起来的话，还成为强者的话，等老子找到带老子来的，看我不好好教训下他。把老子从地球带来这里，什么都不给，还成一个弃婴丢在那么危险的地方，
要不是遇到好心人，说不定老子就成妖兽的盘中餐了。真是越想越气，他奶奶的，这开局见状太糟糕了。人家穿越都有金手指或者其他什么大机缘，老子穿越什么毛都没有。”正当他还在生气心里骂人时，三人已经到了一个普通的院落之中了，
陈晓云抱着姬云生，温柔看着他笑着说道：“小家伙，我家还不错吧，虽然有可能比不上你真正的家，但你放心好了，以后姐姐肯定会让你和爹爹，过上更好的日子的。”姬云生一听回过神来，看了看周围，心里喃喃道：“卧槽，这尼玛是别墅吧，
哎呦不对，这要是放在地球应该是古代的府邸了。就这生活质量水平，简直比我在地球好上不知多少了，以前想都不敢想能住在如此的房子里。”他感动的都流泪了，陈晓云见状顿时心疼起来，温柔笑着问道：“小家伙，难道你不满意吗？
想来也对，你的出生肯定不凡，以后姐姐会努力让你和爹爹，过上更好的日子的。不过也只能等姐姐修为强大了，地位更加高了，才能让你们生活的更好，现在只能委屈你们了。”姬云生一听连忙摇头，陈晓云见状也是疑惑起来了，温柔笑着问道：“
弟弟，难道你不嫌弃这么差劲的住房吗？”姬云生一听连忙点头，心里喃喃道：“我的姐啊！就这房屋我嫌弃什么，唉！果然还是修炼者的世界我看不懂，这种房屋放在地球起码几千万，还不一定能买到。”陈晓云一听更加怜惜姬云生了，温柔笑着说道：“
以后我就叫你云弟弟怎么样？完整的小名就叫云生，毕竟你被爹爹捡到时，是在云荒山，就取前面一字，后面生一字代表你出生不凡，以后也能成就不凡。”姬云生一听连忙点头，开心的笑着，心里喃喃道：“哎呦！卧槽了，我本来就叫姬云生，
小名取这样，简直太有缘了吧！不会有什么大能操控一切吧！为什么会那么巧合呢？算了算了，想那么多干嘛！以后的事以后再说吧，只要能修炼的话，变得强大的话，什么真相都会知道了。”陈晓云见姬云生很喜欢她取的小名，也是更加开心了，
笑着温柔说道：“云弟弟，以后就由姐姐罩着你了，就这么说定了，就算你到时候没有测试出修炼资质的话，姐姐也是一样会护着你的。”姬云生一听满是感动，真想亲口说声：“谢谢！”可惜的事，他如今做不到，他也只是因为自己是婴儿说不了话，
没有想到的事，以后直到他十三岁时，才能开口说话，心里喃喃道：“晓云姐，真是个善良之人，以后要是有机会，我能修炼强大，我也不会负你的，到时候就由我来保护你。”
content_en:
When Chen Xiaoyun heard this, he replied with a gentle smile: "I know, dad, I promise I won't do it again in the future, okay! You have said this so many times, and my daughter is tired of hearing it." Seeing this, Chen Ming smiled helplessly and replied: "Dad, don't talk anymore, let's go back and cook. The little guy must be hungry too, after all, the little guy is so small.
Don't let him starve to death. "When Chen Xiaoyun heard this, he said with a serious face: "Dad, I don't have to bear grudges against my mother, but when I reach enough cultivation, I will never let go of anyone who has caused my father to lose his cultivation. This matter has been decided like this. No matter who the other party is, dad will not be able to stop me when the time comes. "Chen Ming smiled and replied:"
Xiaoyun, dad knows. After you understand it, if you want revenge, dad will definitely not stop you. "Ji Yunsheng murmured in his heart: "I'll go, I heard so much from the two of them, is there any hidden secret in this matter? It seems that Xiaoyun's mother has nothing to do with this matter. After all, I didn't read so many novels in vain.
It's a pity that I'm just a baby now and can't help them. I just hope that if I go to that sect then, I can have the qualifications to practice! After all, these two people are my life-saving grace now, so I have to help them. I'm really convinced. Which bastard brought me here? He doesn't even have the golden finger as promised.
There is nothing like meeting a great old man who cultivates immortality. I'm really convinced, I won't just travel through time and be a supporting role! If I can cultivate and become a strong person, I will wait until I find the person who brought me here and see if I don’t teach him a lesson. You brought me here from the earth, gave me nothing, and left you like an abandoned baby in such a dangerous place.
If I hadn't met some kind-hearted people, I might have become the monster's meal. The more he thought about it, the angrier he became. Damn it, this was such a bad start. Other people have golden fingers or other great opportunities when they time travel, but I don’t have any luck with time travel. "While he was still angry and cursing in his heart, the three of them had already arrived in an ordinary courtyard.
Chen Xiaoyun hugged Ji Yunsheng, looked at him tenderly and said with a smile: "Little guy, my home is not bad, although it may not be as good as your real home, but don't worry, my sister will definitely let you and your father live a better life in the future." Ji Yunsheng came to his senses after hearing this, looked around, and murmured in his heart: "Damn it, this is a villa, right?
Oops, no, if this was placed on Earth, it would be an ancient mansion. This quality of life is infinitely better than what I had on Earth. I never dared to live in such a house before. He was so moved that he shed tears. When Chen Xiaoyun saw this, he immediately felt distressed and asked with a gentle smile: "Little guy, aren't you dissatisfied?"
It's right to think about it. Your birth must be extraordinary. From now on, my sister will work hard to let you and your father live a better life. However, we can only wait until my sister's cultivation becomes stronger and her status becomes higher, so that you can live a better life. Now I can only wrong you. "Ji Yunsheng shook his head quickly when he heard this. Chen Xiaoyun also became confused when he saw this, and asked with a gentle smile: "
Brother, don’t you dislike such a bad housing? "Ji Yunsheng nodded quickly upon hearing this and murmured in his heart: "My sister! What do I dislike about this house? Alas! Sure enough, I can't understand the world of cultivators. This kind of house costs at least tens of millions on earth, but it may not be possible to buy it. Chen Xiaoyun felt even more pity for Ji Yunsheng when he heard this, and said with a gentle smile: "
How about I call you Brother Yun from now on? The complete nickname is Yunsheng. After all, when you were picked up by your father, you were in Yunhuang Mountain, so the first character and the second character represent that you were born extraordinary and will achieve extraordinary things in the future. "Ji Yunsheng nodded quickly when he heard this, smiled happily, and murmured in his heart: "Oh!! Damn it, my original name was Ji Yunsheng.
It’s so fateful that my little name is like this! There can’t be any great power that can control everything! Why is it such a coincidence? Forget it, forget it, why are you thinking so much! Let’s talk about the next thing later. As long as you can practice and become stronger, you will know the truth about everything. "Chen Xiaoyun was even happier when she saw that Ji Yunsheng liked her nickname very much.
He smiled and said softly: "Brother Yun, my sister will protect you from now on. It's settled. Even if you don't test your cultivation qualifications by then, my sister will still protect you. Ji Yunsheng was so moved when he heard this that he really wanted to say: "Thank you!" "It's a pity that he can't do it now. He just can't speak because he is a baby.
What he didn't expect was that he wouldn't be able to speak until he was thirteen years old, and he murmured in his heart: "Sister Xiaoyun, you are such a kind person. If I have the opportunity in the future and I can become stronger, I will not let you down. I will protect you then. "
